name: Genau so! Allgäu Campingplatz
beschreibung: The campsite “Genau so! Allgäu Campingplatz” is located in the west of Tirol, in the middle of the Allgäuer Alpenraum. The location is characterized by mountains, forests, and meadows. The surroundings offer hiking trails and, in winter, ski areas. The facilities include a sanitary building and well-maintained pitches. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature. Guests can expect immediate access to nature for outdoor activities. The nearby village provides supplies that complement the stay. The site is designed for camping holidaymakers.
